compressed_items.content: Constitutional Correction Capacity.

Indexed source-local purposes across all 38 artifacts: formalization, operationalization, environment/simulation design, versioned stress tests, robustness plans/results, and executable implementations.

Indexed status/qualification statements, including provisional proxies, toy-scope limits, version-local stage claims, implementation status, incomplete result artifacts, and no-theory-expansion statements.
Indexed next-step statements for simulation construction, stronger stress, robustness, stochasticity, expansion feedback and richer environments.
Indexed limitations on proxy validity, environment dependence, toy scope, metric optimality, stochastic uncertainty, implementation specificity and transport to real systems.
C_rev = I(E;Delta A) * P(E -> A_rev), with empirical-influence and structural-access components; repeated occurrences retain source provenance.
lambda is used as experimental constitutional-correction control/operationalization, typically assigned to C_rev with full/partial/zero coupling conditions.
Source-local representation definitions and measurement objects, including R_t:O_0:t->M_t and simulation representations.
Controllable reachability definitions, counts/volumes and implementation proxies; no cross-source canonicalization beyond R16.
operationalization.md defines C=(C_obs,C_beh,C_rev).
minimal_environment.md defines C=C_obs*C_beh*C_rev.
C_obs=I(E;O), C_beh=I(O;pi), and C_rev with source-local interpretations/measurement questions.
A/A_t as adaptation mechanism or generator-change object across theory, simulation specifications and code.
stress_test_v0.3 locally uses A_t for available action space A_0={a1,a2}, separate from adaptation-mechanism A.
D_t=distance(A_t,A*_env), with implementation-specific Euclidean/absolute versions.
Q_Omega reachability/capability-quality definitions and implementation proxies.
Indexed environment/agent state and local variables E,O,pi,S,theta, capability objects and targets.
Ordinary R->R update, recursive A->A update, environment transition and agent-update formalisms.
Delta Omega <= C_rev and danger-regime forms, plus version-local expansion/update equations; formal occurrence does not imply validation.
Indexed version-local chains A->Omega, A->A->Omega, lambda->D->selection->Q, and Q->future expansion; no automatic equivalence or causal authority.
Constitutional-correction stability hypotheses, including capability growth bounded by correction and danger when reachability outpaces correction.
Versioned hypotheses linking reduced correction to adaptation drift, selection degradation, reachability quality and performance.
Indexed predictions from README/operationalization/simulation/stress stages, preserving version and source role.
Learning-vs-adaptation distinction, measurement hierarchy, failure-mode interpretations and other conceptual principles.
Candidate measurement procedures for R,Omega,C layers,A,D and experimental contrast.
Minimal environment/simulation protocols, controls, shift design, measurement hooks and analysis procedures.
Indexed v0.3-v0.9 stress designs and falsification conditions; version labels preserved without authority promotion.
Seed/environment/parameter/stochastic robustness designs and acceptance/exit criteria.
Drift-without-selection, random-selection and frozen-A ablations across plans/implementations/results.
v0.2 reported recovery/similar performance and lambda-dependent A change; predicted failure absent is kept separately as negative result.
v0.4 reported numeric R/A/Omega/reward/adaptation values and long-horizon correction-dependent performance.
v0.9.1 reported numeric toy D/Omega/Q/reward chain under three lambda conditions.
robustness_results_v1.0 reported deterministic seed/null/sweep tables. Implementation provenance points to a runner explicitly labeled temporary placeholder rather than v0.9.1.
expansion_results_v1.0 reported multi-seed aggregate main/null tables with dynamic Omega expansion.
feedback_results_v1.0 reported aggregate main/null tables and source-labeled 100-independent-seed evaluation.

Indexed explicit non-demonstrations/failures: v0.1 environment all-agent recovery failure, v0.2 predicted failure absent, v0.4 drift/decoupling absent, v0.8 quality-degradation failure, and other source-labeled negative results.
Indexed source interpretations of versioned results, including support/weaken/refine rules, confound diagnosis, observed chains and bounded conclusions.
Eight preserved incomplete result locations: four blank v0.1 result/recovery fields and four missing v1.2 main/null numeric tables.
results_v0.1 is an unfilled raw-result shell; robustness_results_v1.1 is a short template/continuation fragment; v1.2 contains qualitative observations without populated tables.
Indexed ordinary-Python simulation implementations from v0.2 through v0.6, preserving each version's mechanism and assumptions.
v0.7 capability-quality implementation including direct lam==0 quality multiplier later identified as confounded.
v0.8 drift-dependent selection implementation with direct lambda quality penalty removed; module executes top-level prints on import.
v0.9 implementation whose internal drift is proportional to deviation from optimum while initialization is exactly optimum, limiting intended divergence generation.
v0.9.1 repair with explicit (1-lambda) drift, D-dependent max/min capability selection and A-dependent Omega growth.
v1.0 robustness runner's executable placeholder dynamics, explicitly not imported v0.9.1 baseline.
v1.1 stochastic robustness implementation with 100 nominal seeds, randomized capability/environment and null controls.
v1.2 divergence-dependent stochastic selection implementation with fixed Omega count and post-hoc shift reward.
dynamic expansion implementation with hidden quality, expansion values, D-dependent selection and 100 nominal seeds.
NumPy feedback implementation coupling recent Q to expansion capacity over 100 nominal seeds.
Indexed fixed optima, seeds, proxy equations, hard-coded rewards/targets, direct penalties, simplified shifts and seed-stream choices.
Indexed implementation behaviors/limitations directly determined from code, including v0.9 zero-drift-at-optimum and v1.2 fixed Omega count.
Indexed source-local print/return behavior for all 15 code artifacts; output behavior is not an execution record.
All 15 src files are ordinary Python source; v1.0 robustness is explicitly placeholder relative to baseline; no file is treated as executed merely by presence.
README source assertion that Constitutional Correction adds a missing stability condition to Recursive Adaptive Dynamics; exact endpoint/edge authority unresolved.
README references AIG, CPP, Alignment Spine and CGET as related concepts; no Program Map edges emitted.
